# GC8613 register values of the sensor maker's 40 fps setting, as drivers/media/i2c/gc8613.c of Rockchip's Linux kernel
# carries it: facts about the sensor, in our own form, none of that file's text. The order of the writes is the sensor
# maker's: Aimorelogy's CVITEK driver writes the registers of its 60 fps setting, of the same family, in the same order.
# Format: `[section]`, then one write a line, register and value in hex.

# The GC8613 YA 3840x2160 linear 10-bit readout at 40 fps: MCLK 24 MHz, 4 lanes, wpclk 351 MHz (HTS 948 = 10.8 us line),
# VTS 2314.
